decisionsAndLimits: No actual upgrade is claimed from53.5-54 Blast Boot part preview or142.5-143 Spinwheel slot-overflow preview. Neither is an installed-stat comparison.

Blast Boot L is confirmed at56. Booyarang R is confirmed at58, but the menu exit at58.5 leaves only a short window; no separate readable R label is approved here. Retain the actual R evidence without prolonging footage.
20.5 extra is hover;21 is the selected Tactical tank with changed purple loadout.27 extra is Bombloons hover;29 is actual A assignment.
Shot Pot R is already equipped when hovered at31 extra; its installed test-range device around54 onward is a separate observable result, not a new menu Equip.

The main weapon remains Primo Wooden Splatana. No Shooter continuous fire/Charger charge-release, Special/Showstopper activation, exact recoil/cooldown or measured DPS is established by these marked states.

The main59-66 target/camera pan and extra36-42 mixed effects have no production tracking mark in this report. Native effects can remain visible; do not fabricate object tracking or attribute every number to one gadget.
Original source and rights basis remain linked in sourceResearch. No express reuse grant or music-free/audio-listening claim is added by this proposal.
